description: Oscillator that reads a wavetable through three modulation algorithms, running at audio rate or a hundred times slower as an LFO

params.text: Switches the oscillator between audio rate and a rate one hundredth of it.
Sets the octave in seven steps, each step moving the pitch by twelve semitones.
Raises the pitch by up to twelve semitones above the octave setting.
Detunes the oscillator by up to a semitone either way.
Attenuates and inverts the signal at the FM CV input, -100% to 100%, with a squared response.
Picks the base waveform the modulation works on, fourteen of them.
Sets the number of interpolation points between 512 and 2047; a higher setting gives a more intricate pattern.
Sets the depth of that modulation algorithm on the base waveform, 0.01 to 1.
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at that modulation input before it reaches the MOD setting, -100% to 100%, with a squared response.

inputs.text: Sets the pitch, twelve semitones per volt.
A rising edge sends the pattern generator back to the start of its cycle, which is most audible in LFO mode.
Adds three base waveform steps per volt to the TYPE knob.
Adds 120 interpolation points per volt to the SIZE knob.
Shifts that MOD setting through its own attenuverter; with this jack empty the MOD knob alone sets the depth.
Modulates the pitch through the FM CV knob, twelve semitones per volt at full setting.
